---
title: "Bayesian inference, interactively"
---

An interactive textbook chapter on Bayesian inference. All Python code runs
in your browser through [Pyodide](https://pyodide.org), so no server is needed.

**Note:** the first page load takes about 30 s while Python and its packages
download. After that, other pages and later visits load faster.

## Contents

1. [Priors](priors.qmd): what we believe before seeing any data
2. [Posteriors](posteriors.qmd): updating that belief with Bayes' rule
3. [Conjugacy](conjugacy.qmd): exact posteriors in closed form
4. [MCMC](mcmc.qmd): sampling the posterior with Metropolis

Each page has an **interactive figure** (move the sliders) and an
**exercise** that your browser checks automatically.
